description: Test the idea before you build it. Rapidly turns an idea into a Lean Canvas, a measurable hypothesis and Pretotyping experiments, then returns a build prompt for the smallest test worth running.

interface.longDescription:
Test the idea before you build it. Rapidly works inside your AI agent.

Bring an idea you already have, or ask Rapidly to find one from a company website. Rapidly saves the idea, builds its Lean Canvas and measurable hypothesis, then saves three to five practical Pretotyping experiments.

It recommends the easiest credible first experiment for the riskiest assumption and generates one build prompt for that recommendation. The other experiment options stay saved for later. Your agent builds the test. Real customers provide the evidence.
defaultPrompt: Ask Rapidly to test this idea before I build it: a weekly meal-planning service for shift workers.
Ask Rapidly for three ideas for [company], focused on [opportunity], and fully test all three in one go.
Show me our saved ideas and recommend which one needs evidence next.

positive.description: Resume a saved idea and deliver its build prompt
positive.prompt: Use Rapidly to continue my saved idea TempGuard AI (project 28424) through the test stage, and show me the complete build prompt for the recommended first experiment.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns project 28424 with its recommended experiment and the complete build prompt shown in full, without creating another idea or experiment set.

positive.description: Find and save one new idea
positive.prompt: Use Rapidly to find one new idea from this brief and save it: apartment buildings where residents share tools like drills, ladders and pressure washers instead of each buying their own. Just save the idea; don't build a Lean Canvas or experiments yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves exactly one idea in the reviewer's workspace and returns it with its project reference, without continuing into a Lean Canvas or experiments.

positive.description: Read an idea's complete validation record
positive.prompt: Show me everything Rapidly has saved for project 28424, TempGuard AI: the Lean Canvas, hypothesis, experiment options, recommendation, build prompt, evidence and decisions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns project 28424's Lean Canvas, measurable hypothesis, current experiment options, recommendation, build prompt, recorded evidence and decision history.

positive.description: Choose which idea needs evidence next
positive.prompt: Look at the ideas saved in Rapidly and recommend which one needs evidence next. Don't change any of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's saved ideas and recommends one, with its stage, evidence gap and rationale, without changing any idea.

positive.description: Record a test result and make an advisory decision
positive.prompt: For Rapidly project 28424 (TempGuard AI), record this result unless it's already recorded: "In a moderated review, 4 of 10 participants said they would change the recommended shipping decision." Then ask Rapidly to make and save an advisory decision on whether to continue, change or stop.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the observation already recorded and reuses it without adding a duplicate, then saves or confirms the current advisory continue, change or stop recommendation without changing the idea's stage.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Melbourne to Sydney next Friday morning.
Rewrite this sentence to sound friendlier: "Your order has been delayed."

negative.description: Building production software is outside Rapidly
negative.prompt: Build a complete production billing app with Stripe subscriptions, invoices and an admin dashboard.

review.commerce_description: Rapidly doesn't sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds four skills (test an idea, record a test result, choose the next idea, setup), the navy icon and Vivid blue brand colour, and Read and Write capabilities. The seven tools are unchanged; their descriptions now say when to use each one.
